output.reason: [ev-cc61618a6c99] describes `{{- ... }}` as a new opt-in notation for shallow substitution and says nested substitution remains the default. By that text, no existing environment changes behaviour unless it adopts the notation. The proposed exposure flags every environment that uses any ClusterPolicy or Policy, and the evidence does not show that those environments are affected. The rendered CRD diffs ([ev-e0408f021210] and the others) concern apiCall.default, not this feature. To settle the exposure we would need evidence on whether policies written before 1.13 that already contain `{{-` are now read differently. If they are, the exposure is policies containing that token; if not, no environment is exposed.
